about: Round 21: sides the DJ added that the listado does not hold (the repo-level database). Merged into the index at load (packages/core/src/load.ts); each names where its year comes from.

songs.title: Me Voy a Baraja
songs.notes: Added round 21 for the DJ's featured-night tanda. Not in the listado. Years: the Spotify album 'Embrujo gitano, Edgardo Donato (1936-1938)' (2CLDdxYcYTvCVaO5VdJqbg) carries it; no dated transfer found.

songs.title: Quién lo Había de Pensar
songs.notes: Added round 21 for the DJ's featured-night tanda. Troilo / Rufino's 1963 RCA sides (the index has Desencuentro and Por Qué la Quise Tanto, 1963); Spotify carries it on the same album "Porque la Quise Tanto". No dated transfer found.

songs.title: Noches de Colón
songs.notes: Added round 21 for the DJ's featured-night tanda. Year: Castillo's Tanturi stint (1941–43); Spotify "Comparsa Criolla" carries it; a later take with Osvaldo Ribó exists (not this side). No dated transfer found.

songs.title: Don Agustín Bardi
songs.notes: Added round 21 for the DJ's featured-night tanda. Pugliese instrumental; Spotify lists several transfers with no recording date — year left unknown until a dated source is found.

songs.title: No Mientas
songs.notes: Added round 21: Tango Bardo (a contemporary orchestra playing D'Arienzo's repertoire), album "D'arienzo Anticrisis" on Spotify (singer Roberto Minondi). Release year to be read when the Spotify API answers (enrich_spotify --dates).

songs.title: Humillación
songs.notes: Added round 21: Tango Bardo, "D'arienzo Anticrisis" (Roberto Minondi).

songs.title: Maipo
songs.notes: Added round 21: Tango Bardo, "D'arienzo Anticrisis" (instrumental).

songs.title: La Cumparsita
songs.notes: Added round 21: Bandonegro (a contemporary orchestra), album "Color Aires" (RecArt, released 2022-09-30; Spotify 71xZvSB3Nrb5HMclJKi9jU, Deezer 1842266617, 235 s); the DJ's closing version. No recording date is published: the index keeps year null (it holds no side after 2008) and the release date here and in the Spotify cache.

songs.title: Desde el Alma
songs.notes: Added for the DJ's featured-night Canaro valses (T15): Canaro instrumental, Spotify 1eNQxurcsXpnSABkovjQdM 'Desde el Alma - Instrumental (Remasterizado)', album 'Colección Completa, Vol. 98 (Remasterizado)', 180 s. The listado holds only the Canaro / Nelly Omar 1947 vocal side (bb07488615). Date 1940-01-24: the Colección Completa series numbers Canaro's sessions by date and Vol. 98 is the 1940-01-24 session.

songs.title: Francia
songs.notes: Added for the DJ's featured-night Canaro valses (T15): Spotify 4gKY2486rJizr3nqXBnHbz, album 'Bailemos El Tango Argentino… Vol. 6', 157 s, no singer credited (played as instrumental). Not in the listado. The recording year is unpublished: year null.

songs.title: Llámale "h"
songs.notes: Added for the DJ's featured-night Típica Víctor tanda (T4): the Alberto Gómez version, Spotify 7aL601bNX5PsjELQaZISPw, album 'Recuerdo', 163 s, credited Orquesta Típica Víctor + Alberto Gómez (another copy: 0b5Z7Upu2I5jBeDtDamf9C on 'Zorzales de Antaño… Tierrita'). The listado holds only the Charlo 1932 take (b313688f75). No recording date is published for the Gómez take: year null (Gómez sang with the OTV 1930–37 per the listado).
